verdict.rationale: Composio ships an official CLI explicitly designed for AI-native workflows, giving coding agents (Codex, Claude Code) and terminal users a local tool surface to connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, and debug projects, plus agent-specific auth (`composio login --agent`) and setup (`composio setup --target auto`). This is documented across multiple first-party docs pages and confirmed by a probe hit. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the CLI itself (only cloud-auth issues are reported in community evidence, not CLI-specific complaints).
